title: DSU: Count Connected Components
statement:
Given N nodes (0-indexed) and E undirected edges, find the number of connected components using Disjoint Set Union (Union-Find).

Two nodes belong to the same component if they are connected directly or transitively.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and E.
The next E lines each contain two integers u and v (an undirected edge).
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of connected components.

examples.explanation: Components: {0,1,2} and {3,4}. Node 4 is isolated → wait, 3-4 connected. So {0,1,2},{3,4} = 2.
No edges, each node is its own component.

starterCode.python:
n, e = map(int, input().split())
edges = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(e)]
